title: fix(app-shell): Studio holds a Notify step whose Title is blank, as it holds a missing one (objectui#12343)
body:
Fixes #12343
Clause-②: no

Studio's Automations pillar now holds a Notify step whose Title is blank, the way it already holds a step whose Title is missing. Nothing is sent, and the held line uses the same "needs input" clause naming Title on the Notify step. This is the objectui half of `@objectstack/spec` 18 refusing a blank Notify title, after objectui#12030.

## Measured first (installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0, worktree base `2312bd9`)

- **A1 holds.** `flowHeldEdit` asked only about an ABSENT input (`heldInputOf` skipped any field with a value). `metadataError.heldEdit-11786.test.ts` carried the PENDING case "a BLANK Title ... it is not held".
- **A2, the measured predicate.** `FlowSchema.safeParse` refuses a Notify title at `nodes.N.config.title` when the title is a string that is empty after JavaScript `trim()`. Refused: `''`, `' '`, a tab, a newline, a no-break space. Accepted: a zero-width space, `' x '`, `'{{ record.name }}'`. That is the spec's own `NON_BLANK_STRING` rule (`source.trim().length` greater than zero, in `shared`, not exported). The spec also refuses a blank title when a `template` is present, refuses a blank-source template envelope and `null` at the title, and refuses a blank `message`. It accepts a blank Screen title.
- **A3, partly.** The spec exports no blank predicate. So the hold has two conditions: the value is a blank string (trim-empty, the spec's notion, cited in the code), AND the flow parse itself refuses the draft at that input's path. The parse's refusal is the condition, so the hold can never be stricter than the contract. The blank test only decides which refusals count as unfinished.

## Change

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts`:
- `heldInputOf` now also returns a visible inspector input whose value is blank text (`isBlankText`) when the flow parse refuses at that input's value path (`valuePathOf` reads the `fallbackPath` the same way `getFieldValue` does).
- `flowHeldEdit` parses the draft with `FlowSchema` at most once, lazily, and only when some input holds a blank. Absent inputs are judged by `specRequiresField` exactly as before.

The landing is the claimed surface. `flow-required-keys.ts` is not touched.

## Pins (`metadataError.heldEdit-11786.test.ts`)

- The PENDING case is **re-pinned**, not duplicated. A blank Title (`''`, spaces, a tab) is held in `en` with `{ input: 'Title', step: 'Notify' }` and the node target. Each body is paired with the parse's own verdict, `['nodes.2.config.title']`.
- `zh`: a blank Title is held, named `标题`.
- Controls, each with the parse's verdict on the same body:
  - not held: a filled Title, a `{{ }}` template Title, and a `template` in place of a Title;
  - not held: a Title of `null`, which the parse refuses for the kind of value it holds, not for being blank text; its refusal shows;
  - not held: a blank Title on a Screen step, whose contract accepts it.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` at `645414a`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 failed | 168 passed (169)`, `Tests 1 failed | 1237 passed (1238)`. The one failure was my own control. I had assumed the parse refuses `'Hi {name}'` as a Notify title. It does not (measured above), so the control was swapped for `null` in `8ed13a7`.
- At `8ed13a7`, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.heldEdit-11786.test.ts`: `Tests 17 passed (17)`. This run did not hold the verify lock. I queued for about 27 minutes behind sibling runs, then narrowed the run to the one changed test file. `metadataError.ts` is byte-identical between the two commits, so the other 168 files' results at `645414a` still apply.
- **Ablation**, after the fix was committed: `metadataError.ts` was restored to base `2312bd9` (`isBlankText` count 2 to 0 on disk), and the file went `Tests 2 failed | 15 passed (17)`. The two failures were exactly the new blank-Title `en` and `zh` pins. The file was then restored with `git checkout HEAD`. The HEAD blob hash matched, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: **NOT MEASURED, prerequisite not met**. The workspace dependencies' `dist` is not built in this worktree, so the run exits 2 with 1240 errors, most of them `TS2307` for `@object-ui/*` modules. `metadataError.ts` has only the two `TS2307` lines of its own imports and no other error. Left to CI.
- Lint, narrowed to the two changed files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` gives 2 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. The root `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `project` or `projectService`, no `*TypeChecked` preset), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.
- Gates, each exit code recorded: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift` and `i18n-designer-parity` all exit 0. `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 for the unrelated reason on main, objectui#12334 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec ...").

## Acceptance notes

- **The hold is generic over a step's inspector inputs, not special-cased to Title.** The parse also refuses a blank Notify `message` (measured), so a Message of spaces is now held the same way, as "Message needs input". There is no dedicated pin for it.
- **Boundary:** only a blank STRING is held. A template envelope with a blank `source` is also refused at the title, but it is not held, and its refusal shows. Studio's Title control writes strings, so only Advanced (JSON) can produce that envelope.
- **Observation, not filed (carrier: none):** on the installed spec, `FlowSchema.safeParse` accepts a Notify title of `'Hi {name}'`. objectui#12355 recorded that the notify config schema refuses it. I did not trace which path applies the token refusal.

Changeset: `.changeset/12343-hold-blank-notify-title.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
